description: This Python module provides utilities to align subtitle cues with transcript segments, including text processing, timing adjustments, and decision heuristics for robust subtitle synchronization. It exposes a key function `align_subtitles_to_transcript` which performs the alignment based on timing proximity and text similarity with configurable parameters.

methods.description: Aligns subtitle cues to transcript segments using time proximity and text similarity, applying heuristics for timing, overlaps, and text constraints. Returns a list of corrected subtitle cues.
